title: Child multidimensional poverty, World
headline: Child multidimensional poverty: 37 of the 47 countries with data have nothing after 2020
subtitle: Proportion of population living in multidimensional poverty (age: under 18 years old)

data_line: Data: national statistical offices via UN SDG Global Database, series SD_MDP_CSMP, SD_MDP_MUHC, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Child multidimensional poverty: 37 of the 47 countries with data have nothing after 2020. Latest values 2010 to 2024; median year 2010. Countries by year of their latest value on child multidimensional poverty: 47 in all, 37 in 2020 or earlier.
method: Method: latest value per country; 2020 or earlier is not recent.
question: Which countries have found a way to measure child multidimensional poverty more often, and what made it possible?
